title: Clock Speed
subtitle: electro house · a dotted-eighth clock against four-on-the-floor
statement: Stabs every three sixteenths against a kick every four: two clocks running at different speeds, corrected at the end of each bar. A rimshot ticks every 16th, louder on the binary divisions.
intro: Overclocked: everything a little too fast, and it feels great.

sections.name: Cold Start
sections.intent: Kick, ticking rim and hats; the electro bass at bar 9.

sections.name: Wind-up
sections.intent: The dotted stab riff enters behind a filter and opens.

sections.name: Hold
sections.intent: Kick out; stabs as long chords, a riser climbs.
moves: Kick drops 2 beats before the drop.

sections.name: Full Speed
sections.intent: Stabs, screaming lead, electro bass, snare and clap together.
moves: Lead: D, A, D, F, the handshake, then a fall.

sections.name: Tick
sections.intent: Only the ticking rim, the bass and filtered stabs.
sections.feeling: A clock in an empty room.

sections.name: Full Speed II
sections.intent: Back in with the lead an octave up for the last 8 bars.

sections.name: Cool Down
sections.intent: Drums and bass, then drums only.

layers.name: Kick
layers.description: An electro kick: long pitch sweep, hard click, saturated body.
layers.purpose: Four on the floor, the slower clock.

layers.name: Snare, clap & tick
layers.description: Snare and clap together on 2 and 4, a rimshot on every 16th with the metre's binary velocities.
layers.math: rim velocity = 1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.42, 0.28 for whole, half, quarter, 8th, 16th positions

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, rim, snare

layers.name: Hats
layers.description: Metallic hats from six band-limited square oscillators (the 808 recipe): short closed ticks and off-beat open hats, almost no noise.
layers.purpose: The tick of the groove, kept small.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, rim, snare

layers.name: Dotted stabs
layers.description: Supersaw chord stabs every three sixteenths: a dotted-eighth clock against the kick's four.

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Electro bass
layers.description: Saw and square through a driven ladder with a big filter snap: the electro-house growl. Since take 3 it rides above the warm bass, high-passed at 220 Hz: the bite and the talk, not the weight.

instrument.name: Mono Synth
instrument.description: Saw, square and sub oscillators, glide, vibrato and an enveloped resonant filter.

layers.name: Screamer
layers.description: Two detuned saws and a square with glide, vibrato and drive: the handshake (D, A, D, F), then a fall.

instrument.name: Mono Synth
instrument.description: Saw, square and sub oscillators, glide, vibrato and an enveloped resonant filter.

layers.name: Pad
layers.description: Slow supersaw chords for the breaks.

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Synth choir
layers.description: A synth choir: four drifting, vibrato-ed saw singers per note through five choir formants, each chord walking its own vowels. No breath noise.
layers.purpose: Fills the top with voices instead of hiss.

instrument.name: Synth Choir
instrument.description: An ensemble of drifting, vibrato-ed saws per note through five choir formants; tones, no noise.

layers.name: Growl
layers.description: FM, wavefold and vowel-formant growls answering the stabs in the second half of every other bar, a new patch on each hit.

instrument.name: Growl
instrument.description: Per-note FM, wavefold and vowel formants over a clean sine sub: complextro.

layers.name: Warm sub
layers.description: A sine with a touch of triangle, saturated so its second and third harmonics carry it; a soft thump per note.
layers.purpose: The warm foundation: it owns everything below about 250 Hz.

instrument.name: Warm Sub
instrument.description: Sine plus a touch of triangle, saturated for even harmonics, low-passed at 900 Hz; a soft thump per note.

instrument.name: Transition FX
instrument.description: Noise risers, downlifters, impacts, crashes, reversed crashes and sub drops.

layers.name: Machine voice (vocoder)
layers.description: Sing-speak through the vocoder: what a machine does between two beats.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Voice (hook)
layers.description: The hook, human with doubles and blended with the vocoder.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Robots
layers.description: An escapement ticking two to the beat in the Hold and the Tick, a tower gear on each drop, a wind-up toy winding into the build, servo twitches, a retro console at the end.

instrument.name: Robot rack
instrument.description: Machines from the batsynth robot library (servos, droids, modems, coils, turbines, alarms, clocks).

lanes.name: tension (plan)
lanes.description: How tense each section is meant to feel.
